issue_context.title: Validate statements for read-only transactions
issue_context.body:
## Background

This is a subtask of #21094.

Staleness transactions can only be read-only, and statements in these transactions must be read-only.

## Implementation

Call `planner.IsReadOnly` after the statement is parsed and before it's compiled.

Don't miss these special cases:
- Point get & batch point get
- Prepared statements

These cases don't need to be considered:
- `FOR UPDATE` statements are already handled by `planner.IsReadOnly`
- DDL won't be in read-only transactions
comments: According to https://github.com/pingcap/parser/pull/1145 , it seems we can't think `Prepared statements` as `read-only`. @djshow832

> According to [pingcap/parser#1145](https://github.com/pingcap/parser/pull/1145) , it seems we can't think `Prepared statements` as `read-only`. @djshow832

Prepared statements can't be taken as read-only in the transaction retrial mechanism, but it can be executed in read-only staleness transactions because it doesn't touch the database. You don't need to rely on `IsReadOnly` totally.

review_comments:
`planner.IsReadOnly` covers `ExecuteStmt`. Then It invokes `parser/ast.IsReadOnly` to cover `Select, Explain, Show, Do, SetOpr, SetOprSelectList`.
But this switch case does not contain `Do` & `SetOprSelectList`.

I think we better use whitelist, I mean a structure like:
```
if !vars.TxnCtx.IsStaleness ...
if planner.IsReadOnly ... // allow readonly stmts
// allow SplitRegion and other stmts that is not included in planner.IsReadOnly
// forbid all other stmts
```
